metadata.purpose: Current sticky table-header text, also common in sidebar/footer metadata.

shadows.name: annotation-marker

motion.name: onboarding-dot-settle
motion.purpose: Dedicated setup dot alphabet only; not a global transition.

motion.name: onboarding-dot-keyframes
motion.value: @keyframes dot-settle { from { opacity: .12; transform: translateY(1.3px) scale(.5); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

motion.name: onboarding-dot-stagger
motion.purpose: Per-dot CSS delay derived from alphabet position.

motion.name: onboarding-reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .dot-pixel { animation: none; opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

rampMethodology.status: SYNTHESIZED REFERENCE RAMPS; no ramp colors are implemented CSS palette tokens.
rampMethodology.sourceColorSpace: CSS hex sRGB; source hex remains normative in DESIGN frontmatter.
rampMethodology.conversion: sRGB gamma decode -> linear-sRGB -> OKLab (Björn Ottosson matrices) -> OKLCH.
rampMethodology.hue: Preserve each source color OKLCH hue at all eight steps.
rampMethodology.chroma: Source C * min(1, L/0.30, (1-L)/0.30), then reduce C by 50-iteration binary search if required for linear-sRGB gamut, preserving L and hue.
rampMethodology.alpha: Preserve source alpha, including overlay80% in dark themes and overlay136/255 in Paper. Ramp swatches still composite differently by canvas.
rampMethodology.precision: Six decimals in CSS strings. All unrounded candidates checked in linear-sRGB gamut.
rampMethodology.canonicalField: Intentionally omitted: source hex is canonical, not an approximation of an incumbent OKLCH token. Avoid suggesting a new primitive source of truth.

components.name: Default button
components.description: Shared 28px minimum-height control. Transparent resting fill, line border, 4px corners; orange border/text on hover. Disabled buttons retain the implemented hover rules while opacity and cursor change.
components.html:
<button class="ds-button" type="button">Save candidate</button>
<button class="ds-button" type="button" disabled>Saving…</button>

components.name: Primary button
components.description: General primary action uses the selected surface, soft border and ink text; hover uses the hover surface with orange border/text. The settings Save bar has a separate orange-fill override and is not this component.
components.html:
<button class="ds-button ds-primary" type="button">Save context</button>
<button class="ds-button ds-primary" type="button" disabled>Saving…</button>

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Secondary is an orange-text variant of the shared outlined button; it is not a muted filled button.
components.html:
<button class="ds-button ds-secondary" type="button">Done</button>
<button class="ds-button ds-secondary" type="button" disabled>Done</button>

components.name: Compact button
components.description: Compact keeps the shared 28px minimum height and orange text. Its more specific 2px 10px padding survives the later general button override.
components.html:
<button class="ds-button ds-compact" type="button">Search context</button>
<button class="ds-button ds-compact" type="button" disabled>Search context</button>

components.name: Text button
components.description: Muted text with a transparent border; hover changes text to orange and adds the row surface. Shape and minimum height remain shared.
components.html:
<button class="ds-button ds-text" type="button">Cancel</button>
<button class="ds-button ds-text" type="button" disabled>Cancel</button>

components.name: Standard text input
components.description: Square field from the capture form: surface background, 1px line border, 6px 8px padding and 12px type. Parent grid gap7px and label margin5px reproduce that form context. Settings fields instead use 5px corners, 32px minimum height and the background token.

components.name: Workspace navigation selection
components.description: Daily navigation in the normal 180px sidebar. Selected row uses selected fill, ink text and a 2px orange leading rule; shortcuts stay muted except for the selected orange key. The specimen includes the real sidebar padding/background/border, but no fixed viewport height.
components.html: Daily

components.name: Settings badge
components.description: The implemented small settings badge, not a generalized status-chip system. Muted 9px text on row fill, a soft border and 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-settings-badge { color: var(--muted, #aaa6bb); background: var(--row, #282739); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #37364d); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px; font: 400 9px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; font-synthesis: none; flex: none; }

components.name: Ruled panel
components.description: Effective workspace panel has only a soft top rule, transparent fill, square corners and 18px top padding. The heading is static with 16px bottom margin; focus-within does not brighten it. This specimen is the implemented Processing history heading in its empty state.

components.name: Pinned source evidence excerpt
components.description: Bragbook's revision-and-line citation beside a quoted source passage. Recessed excerpt with a 1px line rule and cyan source button. The sentence is explicitly synthetic specimen content; the production button opens that exact saved revision and line.
components.html: [Synthetic example] Completed the project handoff.

components.name: Filled settings card and switch
components.description: Deliberate exception to the ruled panel: a surface-filled settings card with soft border and 7px corners. Includes the actual automatic-summary switch with associated label/help. Switch is 34×20px with a radial-gradient thumb; checked fill is orange. No transition is implemented.
components.html: Finish a recording. Get a summary and cited action items.

narrative.overview:
Thesaurus is a quiet place to recover context and continue working. A persistent sidebar, monospaced text, restrained color and fine dividers give private work memory a stable, inspectable form. The user chose “The Quiet Console” as the system’s description; calm, precise and quietly technical are editorial descriptions of the existing interface.

The workspace is compact and flat. Headings establish place without competing with actions, metadata stays close to its subject, and source passages remain visibly connected to their citations. Settings use bounded groups; onboarding carries the more expressive dot lettering. These are distinct patterns within the same interface.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navigation and a stable workspace frame.
One monospaced family, with hierarchy carried by size, spacing and tone.
Flat tonal surfaces, fine rules and inset selection markers.
Compact controls with explicit keyboard focus.
Citations and source passages presented as part of the work.

rules.name: The Role Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Use the existing theme variable for its implemented role. The variable named orange also carries focus, attention and review states; it is not an exclusive primary-action color.

rules.name: The Scoped Expression Rule
rules.body: Keep the dot alphabet and its entrance animation in onboarding. Workspace headings and operational copy use the shared monospaced family.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate workspace regions with tone, spacing and fine rules. Keep the existing inset markers as state indicators rather than treating them as elevation shadows.

dos: Do use the active theme’s complete palette and retain distinct role tokens even when their values coincide.
Do preserve the thin orange focus outline and the leading rule on selected navigation and cited lines.
Do let Bragbook headings and source passages wrap; keep their established reading widths.
Do use the transparent, top-ruled panel for ordinary workspace sections and the filled card for settings groups.
Do retain visible labels, source references and the existing reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't restore the superseded outer terminal frame, horizontal main navigation or zebra table rows when extending the current workspace.
Don't turn every primary action into an orange-filled button; that fill is a scoped settings Save treatment.
Don't apply onboarding dot lettering or its animation to ordinary workspace headings.
Don't treat the measurement aliases or synthesized preview ramps as implemented CSS scales.
Don't describe the bundled font as having a supplied medium or bold face, or claim accessibility conformance from this extraction.
